description: Stage G diagnostic SED points for v2_baseline24.

reference_spectrum.name: Hu 2023 / 1LHAASO WCDA full-array Crab PL reference
reference_spectrum.source: Hu 2023 / 1LHAASO WCDA full-array catalog PL value used in roadmap
notes: This is an analytic PL curve from the full-array catalog fit, not digitized Fig. 6-32 SED points.
It should not be labeled WCDA-1/Pool-1.

wcda1_pool1_reference.name: LHAASO-WCDA-1 / Pool-1 Crab Table 1 SED points
wcda1_pool1_reference.paper: Performance of LHAASO-WCDA and Observation of Crab Nebula as a Standard Candle
wcda1_pool1_reference.note: Final CPC HTML Table 1 values are used. The arXiv v1 PDF/text has exponent mismatches for at least the 60-100 and 300-400 Nhit rows, so it is not used as the numeric authority here.

external_crab_sed_references.description: External Crab SED points added for visual comparison only; they are not used by Stage G fitting.
external_crab_sed_references.unit: E^2 dN/dE in TeV cm^-2 s^-1

magic_joint_crab.label: MAGIC
magic_joint_crab.paper: VHE gamma-ray observation of the Crab Nebula and its pulsar with the MAGIC telescope
magic_joint_crab.notes: Albert et al. 2008 table points, mirrored by naima CrabNebula_spectrum.ecsv; energy flux values converted from erg cm^-2 s^-1 to TeV cm^-2 s^-1. MAGIC 2015 reaches close to 30 TeV, but no public original flux-point table was found, so it is not mixed into this diagnostic plot.

hess_2024_stereo.label: H.E.S.S.
hess_2024_stereo.paper: The Crab Nebula with H.E.S.S.: long-term measurements of the TeV spectrum
hess_2024_stereo.notes: Stereo CT1-4 flux points; e_ref in TeV and E^2 dN/dE in TeV cm^-2 s^-1.

hawc_2019_nn.label: HAWC NN
hawc_2019_nn.source: HAWC 2019 ApJ Table 4, neural-network estimator flux points
hawc_2019_nn.paper: Measurement of the Crab Nebula Spectrum Past 100 TeV with HAWC
hawc_2019_nn.notes: Flux points are E^2 dN/dE at simulated median energy; statistical errors only. The final 177-316 TeV upper limit is recorded but not plotted as a detection point.
